introduction: 211 New York connects people with local services through regional providers covering the state around the clock.
description: 211 New York connects people with local services through regional providers covering the state around the clock.

sections.who: Anyone can request resource information. Each referred organization determines eligibility.
sections.get: Referrals include food, housing, utilities, transport and other needs. Funding is not reserved by a referral.
